summary: The source selects one of five launchers by local average row length, then the timed runtime-count loop indirectly invokes that launcher once per repetition. Compiled evidence now includes the selector's function-pointer targets, timed indirect call/backedge, and all five actual launcher helper bodies (TPR 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), each of which launches its matching kernel specialization. Existing complete SASS evidence covers all five device variants.
